nights.title: Mamas Gun
nights.name: Mamas Gun
nights.extract: Mamas Gun is a British contemporary soul band. They found early international success with a radio-friendly soul pop sound. They made 5 full-length albums with evolving personnel, reaching a sound rooted in classic soul with alternative/progressive leanings. Golden Days (2018) marked a major turning point, the band having recorded and produced it themselves.

nights.title: Boy Golden - Good Goddamn Another Tour
nights.name: Boy Golden
nights.extract: Boy Golden is the stage name of Liam Duncan, a Canadian alternative country singer-songwriter based in Winnipeg, Manitoba.

nights.title: Blackie and the Rodeo Kings
nights.name: Blackie and the Rodeo Kings
nights.extract: Blackie and the Rodeo Kings are a Canadian folk rock–alternative country band with blues and country influences. The band was formed in 1996, in Hamilton, Ontario, by Tom Wilson, Stephen Fearing, and Colin Linden.

nights.title: Keenan Te: The Afterthought Tour
nights.name: Keenan Te
nights.extract: Keenan Te is an Australian singer-songwriter of Vietnamese and Cambodian heritage. He is known for piano-driven ballads and songs that gained popularity through TikTok.

nights.title: GRYFFIN
nights.name: Gryffin
nights.extract: Daniel Griffith, known by his stage name Gryffin, is an American musician, DJ, and music producer. He gained recognition for remixing some well-known songs such as Tove Lo's "Talking Body", Maroon 5's "Animals" and Years & Years' "Desire".
